genuine_expected: CurveForceN direct field from unmodified OR1.6.1 DLL after Simulator.Update; no formula-generated expected force
input_scope: Isolated prescribed geometry/mass/vehicle speed/coefficient only; no observed force, radius, cant, pose, speed, cylinder or coefficient is supplied to a closed trajectory
phase: CurveForceN rowN uses CurrentCurveRadiusM/SuperElevationM rowN-1, AbsSpeedMpS rowN and train coefficient published in car order. Vehicles0..6 see head0 current coefficient; vehicle7 sees rear7 current coefficient. Coefficient uses previous AbsSpeedMpS of that locomotive and current base factor. Initial tick0 is context only.
coefficient_derivation: Read previous locomotive AbsSpeedMpS and current BaseFrictionCoefficientFactor from original observations; compute source expression in Single, (7.5f/(prevAbsSpeed*3.6f+44f)+.161f)*base. This derived input is labelled; post-update rear coefficient directly observed confirms equality. No expected force is derived.
single_rounding: Inputs/expected parse native round-trip decimal and round to original IEEE754 Single. Coefficient rounds after each original Single operation.
selection: 32 fixed post-update ticks across startup, acceleration, coasting, braking and finalrest; replace fixedtick14000 by observedmaximum summed nativecurve tick when distinct; all8cars each tick. Output-extremum selection determines coverage, not thresholds.
